        vals = vals.replace(";", "")
        parsed_vals = []
        for v in vals.split(","):
            v = v.strip().strip('"')
            if re.fullmatch(r"\d+", v):
                parsed_vals.append(int(v))
            else:
                parsed_vals.append(v)
        result[key] = parsed_vals
    
    return result

headers = ["wtype_id", "name", "status", "orgId", "careType", "specialtyId", "contextId"]

for r in range(2, ws_in.max_row + 1):
    wtype_id = ws_in.cell(r, col_map["wtype_id"]).value
    name = ws_in.cell(r, col_map["name"]).value
    status = ws_in.cell(r, col_map["status"]).value
    filter_text = ws_in.cell(r, col_map["filter"]).value or ""

    care_types = parsed.get("careType", [None])
    specialty_ids = parsed.get("specialtyId", [None])
    context_ids = parsed.get("contextId", [None])
    
    for org_id, care_type, specialty_id, context_id in itertools.product(
        org_ids, care_types, specialty_ids, context_ids
    ):
        output_rows.append([
            wtype_id,
            name,
            status,
            org_id,
            care_type,
            specialty_id,
            context_id
        ])

# Modify only Output!A1:G10
for row in range(1, 11):
    for col in range(1, 8):
        ws_out.cell(row=row, column=col).value = None

for r_idx, row_values in enumerate(output_rows[:10], start=1):
    for c_idx, value in enumerate(row_values[:7], start=1):
        ws_out.cell(row=r_idx, column=c_idx).value = value

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
